ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line segment AB passes through the center O and intersects the circle $\odot O$ at points A and C, $\angle B=30^\circ$. The line BD is tangent to the circle $\odot O$ at point D. What is the degree measure of $\angle ADB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OD, as shown in the diagram,\\
BD is tangent to $\odot$O at D,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$ODB$=90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle$B$=30^\circ$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$DOB$=60^\circ$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$A$=30^\circ$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle$ADB$=180^\circ-\angle$B$-\angle$A=$180^\circ-30^\circ-30^\circ$=\boxed{120^\circ}

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the image shows A, O, C, B collinear on a horizontal line, with O the circle center, A and C on the circle, B outside to the right, D on the upper part of the circle, AD drawn, and BD tangent at D. Use the text fact that ∠B=30° and BD is tangent. Draw/consider radius OD. Since a radius to a tangent point is perpendicular to the tangent, ∠ODB=90°. In right triangle ODB, ∠OBD=30°, so ∠DOB=60°. Because A, O, B are collinear and OA is opposite OB, ∠AOD=180°−60°=120°. Since OA=OD are radii, triangle AOD is isosceles, so ∠OAD=∠ADO=30°. Thus ∠DAB=30° because AB lies on AO. Finally in triangle ADB, ∠ADB=180°−30°−30°=120°.

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: the image shows A and C as the two circle intersections of the horizontal line through O, so AC is a diameter, D is on the upper semicircle, and B is an external point with secant B-C-A and tangent BD. 再推理：因为 AC 是直径，所以上半圆弧满足 m(弧AD)+m(弧DC)=180°。由切线 BD 和割线 BA 在外部点 B 形成的角定理，∠DBA=30° 等于所截两弧差的一半，即 30°=1/2[m(弧AD)-m(弧DC)]，所以 m(弧AD)-m(弧DC)=60°。联立 m(弧AD)+m(弧DC)=180°，得到 m(弧AD)=120°，m(弧DC)=60°。现在在 D 点用切线-弦定理：∠ADB 由切线方向 DB 和弦 DA 形成，并且图中所求的是三角形内部的较大角，它截的是 AD 的大弧。AD 的小弧为 120°，所以 AD 的大弧为 360°-120°=240°，因此 ∠ADB=1/2×240°=120°。

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: \textbf{Solution:} Connect OD, as shown in the diagram.\\ BD is tangent to $\odot O$ at D,\\ $\therefore$ $\angle ODB = 90^\circ$,\\ $\because$ $\angle B = 30^\circ$\\ $\therefore$ $\angle DOB = 60^\circ$\\ $\therefore$ $\angle A = 30^\circ$\\ $\therefore$ $\angle ADB = 180^\circ - \angle B - \angle A = 180^\circ - 30^\circ - 30^\circ = \boxed{120^\circ}$
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, the four points A, O, C, B are on the same horizontal straight line, O is the center of the circle, A and C are on the circle, and B is on the outside right side of the circle; D is above the circle, AD and BD are connected, among which BD is the tangent through point D, and 30° is marked at B.
Then reason: Because BD is tangent to the circle at point D, the radius OD is perpendicular to BD, obtaining ∠ODB=90°. The problem gives ∠OBD=30°, so in right triangle ODB, ∠DOB=60°. Also because the three points A, O, B are collinear, OA and OB are in opposite directions, therefore ∠AOD=180°−60°=120°. Since OA=OD are both radii, triangle AOD is an isosceles triangle, so ∠OAD=∠ADO=(180°−120°)/2=30°. Because A, O, B are collinear, ∠DAB=∠OAD=30°. Finally, in triangle ADB, ∠ABD=30°, ∠DAB=30°, so ∠ADB=180°−30°−30°=120°.
